level1_releases.name: v2.1.317
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
- Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
- Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
- Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
- Added `anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans
- Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
- Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
- Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
- Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged)
- Fixed `claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab
- Fixed `claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page
- Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps
- Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls
- Fixed session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating
- Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of i

level1_releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.22.6
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.6

**Release Date:** November 2, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~776 PRs merged since v0.22.5 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `f0d94882e89`, the window since v0.22.5 contains **3,448 non-merge commits** across **4,316 changed files** (+248,579 / −94,077), **776 merged PRs** and **385 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: the Webapp served from the gateway's own listener (`hermes webapp`, a Desktop Web Access pane to open it on your network or your own URL behind Nous sign-in, and Desktop plugins loading in a browser tab), `/model reset` to clear a session's model pin without losing history, per-skill locks against autonomous writes (lockable from the Desktop Capabilities pane), opt-in prepared compaction (`compression.prepare_ahead`), `hermes cron cancel` plus a per-job missed-run policy and a Stop button in the Desktop cron editor, `/delegation` choices saved for the next session, `hermes migrate` and setup moving Grok Bot and OpenBot users over, opt-in OS-keychain storage for the vault key, the catalog's `requires_hermes` enforced at plugin install and update, agent-picked ElevenLabs voices in `text_to_speech`, a `pre_llm_call` hook that can block a turn before inference, Desktop group chat rename, disband, mentions and attachment paste, every profile shown as a Desktop sidebar section, Telegram video notes, Slack emoji reactions in thread context, and resumable downloads in the package manager.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.5...v0.22.6](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.5...v0.22.6)
